title: Two Sum
summary: Return the indexes of two numbers whose sum equals the target.
algorithmSteps: Create a map from previously seen values to their indexes.
For each value, compute the complement needed to reach the target.
Return the saved complement index and the current index when the complement exists.

examples.explanation: The values at indexes 0 and 1 add up to 9.

edgeCases: The matching value may appear twice at different indexes.
Negative values and a negative target are valid.
Return null when no pair exists.
